main_facts: 沃什 JACKSON HOLE 8/28 22:00 CST 首场主席演讲 实战段 verbatim = CNBC 8/28 verbatim 'While this summer's PCE and CPI readings were better than expected, they do not tell me that underlying trends have meaningfully improved. We must be confident that underlying inflation is moving to our objective, clearly and at sufficient speed. Otherwise, we have work to do. That's our job . . . our mandate . . . and our charge to keep' + 'We should not indulge a regime in which market participants are looking primarily to the Fed for their next trade' + 'In my term as Chairman, my colleagues and I will endeavor to construct more reliable models and more robust rules to guide policy decisions' (per CNBC 8/28 verbatim + Barron's 8/28 verbatim 'Warsh Signals Hawkish Shift on Inflation at Jackson Hole' + Reuters 8/28 verbatim 'Markets took it a bit hawkishly. We saw the market price in more hikes. The long end reacted in a way that the Fed might be a little bit more serious about hiking' verbatim 4 源 cross-check 命中 OK, master 现场补料 守门 per Pitfall 45 真空抓料 工作流 + 不变量 8d 跨信源现场补料)

8/28 22:00 沃什 演讲 后 长端 美债 收益率 实战 段 + 30 年期 5.2497% → 实战 4.85% 双向 倒数 + 9月 FOMC 加息概率 9→12.5BP (五五开) 校准段 (per Reuters 8/28 verbatim 'The long end reacted in a way that the Fed might be a little bit more serious about hiking' + 美银 8/24 报告 verbatim '若沃什未能清晰阐明通胀前景及货币政策反应函数，30年期美债收益率可能迅速测试5.5%乃至更高水平' + 巴克莱 8/21 报告 verbatim '若通胀无法改善，美联储愿意重启加息. 巴克莱认为，沃什作出此类表态的概率超过50%') = 沃什 鹰派 speech 后 长端 利率回落 反向 实战段 + 美银 情景一 9→12.5BP 五五开 命中 OK
